$eligibleReal = @'
const fs=require('fs');const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.dip-local/production-frozen/docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-production-operations.json'));const snapshot=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.dip-local/production-frozen/.dip-local/production-real-sources.json'));const ids=new Set(snapshot.sources.flatMap(x=>[x.id,x.path]));for(const kind of ['task','document']){const rows=r.rows.find(x=>x.name==='current-real-project-known-queries').rows.filter(x=>x.kind===kind);const eligible=rows.filter(x=>x.gold.some(g=>ids.has(g)));console.log(JSON.stringify({kind,total:rows.length,eligible:eligible.length,R1:eligible.filter(x=>x.sourceR1).length,R5:eligible.filter(x=>x.sourceR5).length,absent:rows.filter(x=>!eligible.includes(x)).map(x=>x.gold)}));}
'@
node -e $eligibleReal
